title: DTDD: Divergence-Triggered Dynamic Distillation for Reliable On-Policy Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2610.19302v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision on student rollouts, but this supervision can become unreliable when the student and teacher diverge, either because of a large initial policy gap or compounding errors in long-horizon reasoning and tool use. We introduce Divergence-Triggered Dynamic Distillation (DTDD), an adaptive OPD framework that uses segment-level student-teacher divergence to trigger teacher takeover during training. When divergence triggers an intervention during reasoning, the student prefix continues to receive standard OPD supervision. The teacher then generates a recovery suffix, which the student learns through behavior cloning, using cross-entropy on the teacher-generated tokens. We evaluate DTDD in three regimes: long-horizon reasoning, distillation from a base initialization without offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and multi-turn agents. translated_title: DTDD：面向可靠在策略监督的发散触发动态蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）在学生模型的 rollout 轨迹上提供密集的 token 级监督，但当学生与教师模型出现分歧时，这种监督可能变得不可靠——分歧可能源于较大的初始策略差距，或长程推理与工具使用中的误差累积。我们提出了发散触发动态蒸馏（DTDD），这是一种自适应的 OPD 框架，利用分段级别的师生分歧在训练过程中触发教师接管。当分歧在推理过程中触发干预时，学生的前缀部分继续接受标准的 OPD 监督；随后教师生成一个恢复后缀，学生通过行为克隆学习该后缀，即在教师生成的 token 上使用交叉熵损失。我们在三种场景下评估 DTDD：长程推理、从基础初始化出发且无需离线监督微调（SFT）的蒸馏，以及多轮智能体。我们还比较了其他触发器设计的（效果）……
tldr: 提出发散触发动态蒸馏（DTDD）框架，通过监测分段级师生分歧自动触发教师接管并生成恢复后缀供学生行为克隆学习，从而在长程推理、无SFT的基础初始化蒸馏和多轮智能体场景中保障在策略蒸馏监督的可靠性。
en_tdlr: DTDD is an adaptive on-policy distillation framework that uses segment-level student-teacher divergence to trigger teacher takeover, where the teacher generates recovery suffixes learned via behavior cloning, ensuring reliable supervision across long-horizon reasoning, base-initialization distillation without SFT, and multi-turn agent settings.
